text_block_list.text:
One day, 
we paid a visit to the club where 
Phalaenopsis was raised 
to report on our recent progress—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—And so, moving forward, 
I shall continue to devote myself 
alongside my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I'm so glad... 
Truly, I am.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
To know that you have found 
such a wonderful Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
And... that Racewear. 
It truly suits you well.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
Look over there. 
Even the children's eyes are sparkling.

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, so pretty...!

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Miss Phaleno is so cool! 
She's not just pretty... she looks super 
strong!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... "Strong," is it? That is high 
praise indeed. 
After all, this is my—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: attire for battle.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
"To bear the hopes of this beautiful 
garden, 
and bloom upon the battlefield of the 
racetrack."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
"For that sake, I shall rise time and 
again. 
I shall yield to no one."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
"Clad in this garb, 
I would even become a demon."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of those I must protect— 
blade in hand, I shall blossom into a 
magnificent flower."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...A special garment imbued with that very 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Bat-tle-field...? Ka-ta-na...? 
Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you mean sword fighting?! 
Is that why you look like a samurai?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, silly! 
Races! She means races!

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
She means she's gonna try super hard, 
like fighting in a battle! 
That's what it means...!

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Really? 
Aww, hehe...

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
I thought you were gonna play sword 
fighting 
with us again like you used to.

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey...! 
What are you saying?! 
That's rude...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Very well.

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Swordplay. 
Clad in my battle attire, I accept your 
challenge fair and square.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Donning this garb to fight is also for the 
sake 
of the budding flowers nurtured in this 
garden.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
How could I ever turn away the wish 
of a bud waiting to bloom?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Come. Let us play together.

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Here I come! 
Yaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
My, such spirited vigor in your voice. 
You are surely a valiant warrior.

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Prepare yourself! 
Taaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, an ambush? Well played. 
Yet I shall not be felled so easily.

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! 
Phaleno-san, you're so strong!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
Though you little ones are quite 
formidable yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we continue? 
Come at me with everything you've got.

Blossoms sway gently in the breeze, 
as does the lively laughter of the 
children.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
choice_data_list: You looked like you were having fun.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Do you mean the children? Or perhaps... 
myself?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Not that it matters either way.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I am joyful, yes. For is there any sight 
more precious than this?

A beautiful garden bathed in sunlight. 
We simply stood there, quietly taking in 
the serene scene.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. A trivial matter like 
this—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...No. 
It was a battle of the utmost gravity.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Such boundless strength. 
I wonder what splendid blossoms they will 
bloom into.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Until the day those buds blossom— 
I shall carry this racing silk as my 
banner and keep fighting.
